result.title: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
result.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Fifth Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026). Code: https://github.com/denheijmans/robust_multignn
result.summary: Financial transaction networks are naturally represented as multigraphs, where repeated transactions between the same pair of accounts are modeled as distinct edges. Recently proposed multigraph neural network architectures leverage this structure explicitly to achieve a strong performance on anti-money laundering (AML) tasks. However, their robustness to adversaries that manipulate transaction structures to evade detection remains largely unexplored. We present the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training of multigraph neural networks using node-edge incidence matrices, adapting projected gradient descent and projected randomized block coordinate descent methods to optimize structural perturbations over such matrices. We further introduce a cycle-based regularizer that penalizes changes in the global counts of directed 2- and 3-cycles, providing a structural measure of attack plausibility. Experiments on synthetic pattern-detection and realistic AML datasets show that our learned attacks substantially outperform non-learnable perturbation baselines in reducing detection performance (PR-AUC), while adversarial training consistently improves robustness against these attacks. These results demonstrate that multigraph neural networks are vulnerable to learned structural attacks and that adversarial training provides an effective defense. Our code is available at https://github.com/denheijmans/robust_multignn.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究金融交易多重图神经网络的对抗鲁棒性，提出基于节点-边关联矩阵的可扩展结构攻击框架，用投影梯度与随机块坐标下降学习结构扰动，并加入有向 2/3 环计数正则项衡量攻击合理性，同时验证对抗训练可提升鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是金融犯罪检测中的多重图结构攻击与防御，不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的 latent 状态、证据筛选、计算分配或停止决策，也未提供可迁移至 LVR 的具体方法线索。
